convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint by merging backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint
run_convert_cli: run the CLI tool to convert a fine-tune checkpoint to a release checkpoint using --fine-tune-checkpoint and --output-release-checkpoint flags
convert_checkpoint_with_yaml: convert a fine-tune checkpoint and its YAML config to release format by providing both checkpoint and YAML file paths
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to understand how it merges backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint
refactor_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: refactor the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to support additional checkpoint validation or config merging strategies
